news.summary: Health Care Without Harm (HCWH) has published its U.S. Artificial Intelligence Procurement Guide to support healthcare organizations in identifying preferred AI vendors and encourage them to become better stewards of the environment.

news.title: Florida AG sues PBMs, pharmas over rise in insulin prices
news.summary: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier is suing three drug manufacturers as well as three pharmacy benefit managers, alleging that they worked together to drive up the price of insulin and line their own pockets.

news.title: Epic shifts focus to cybersecurity while AI, interoperability agenda still on track, company says
news.summary: Epic Systems is placing greater emphasis on cybersecurity protections as cyber threats continue to escalate. Still, its development roadmap hasn’t changed since it was presented at Epic's August 2026 Users Group Meeting, a spokesperson said.

news.title: Breast cancer and Black women: Investigating the disparities
news.summary: Black women face a far higher breast cancer mortality rate than white women despite having a slightly lower incidence of the disease. In this episode of "Podnosis," we look at what’s driving that disparity and the research aimed at closing the gap.

news.title: AI-enabled Pelago expands from SUD care to mental health, behavioral addictions
news.summary: The new Pelago Behavioral Health Platform means co-occurring conditions can be assessed and treated in a single plan. Behavioral addiction programming includes gambling, gaming and binge eating

news.title: Oracle deepens life sciences push with AI agents, real-world data analytics
news.summary: Oracle is expanding the capabilities of its life sciences AI data platform with domain-trained AI agents, enhanced analytics tools and natural-language data exploration aimed at accelerating clinical research.

news.title: Heidi lands $340M to build 'AI care partner' for clinicians
news.summary: Healthcare startup Heidi landed $340 million to fuel its push beyond clinical documentation into AI-powered workflow automation and agentic capabilities for clinicians.

news.title: As CMS overhauls provider tax policy, hospitals plead for minimal administrative burden, uncertainty

news.title: Enveda reaps $311M series E to feed ambition to become a ‘household name’
news.summary: Enveda has raised a $311 million series E round, positioning the nature-derived drug discovery company to pursue its goal of becoming a household name over the next decade.

news.title: Trump's Department of War bets $47M on Flagship biotechs to develop countermeasures
news.summary: The Department of War has awarded Flagship Pioneering $47 million to develop medical countermeasure technologies against emerging threats.

news.title: Immunovant ends cutaneous lupus program after phase 2 flop
news.summary: Immunovant has stopped development of IMVT-1402 in cutaneous lupus erythematosus after failing a midphase test, closing off one path to market for the anti-FcRn antibody.

news.title: Boehringer adds $250M to value of Variant pact by expanding into cardiovascular disease
news.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has dived deeper into its collaboration with Variant Bio by expanding the collaboration to cover cardiovascular disease to the tune of $250 million.

news.title: GSK aiming to ‘balance West and East’ after Hansoh deal success showed China’s potential
news.summary: GSK has been operating a strategy of “balancing the West and the East” since the Big Pharma’s eyes were opened to the potential of licensing drugs from China two years ago, according to an executive.

news.title: Roche’s phase 3 win tees up fight with Novartis for blockbuster kidney disease market
news.summary: Roche has reported a phase 3 win for sefaxersen in kidney disease, teeing up talks with regulators about the path to approval for the Ionis-partnered, would-be blockbuster candidate.

news.title: Anaconda Biomed snares $56M in funding for endovascular tech
news.summary: Medtech startup Anaconda Biomed has hauled in $53 million to help finish off work on a pivotal trial for its endovascular project.

news.title: Novartis secures new radioligand in $900M deal as competition strengthens
news.summary: As an imposing new competitor begins to take shape, radiopharma leader Novartis has beefed up its pipeline by licensing a preclinical radioligand therapy from a specialist Chinese biotech.

news.title: Celldex monoclonal antibody rebounds with pair of phase 3 wins for chronic skin condition
news.summary: Celldex touted a double phase 3 trial win in patients with treatment-refractory chronic spontaneous urticaria.

news.title: Amgen’s Horizon-acquired fusion protein eases Sjögren's severity in ph. 3 win
news.summary: An investigational drug for the autoimmune condition Sjögren's disease has scored a phase 3 win for Amgen, marking a positive sign for the Horizon Therapeutics-acquired pipeline that has so far struggled to gain traction.

news.title: Vertex’s midstage data amplify kidney disease market opportunity
news.summary: Vertex has reported positive phase 2b data for its kidney disease prospect inaxaplin, boosting its efforts to expand beyond the population targeted in a pivotal trial.

news.title: Lexeo takes up the Mantle in $8M acquisition for Friedreich ataxia assets
news.summary: Lexeo Therapeutics has agreed to acquire Mantle Therapeutics via an upfront payment of $8.3 million, aiming to expand its Friedreich ataxia (FA) portfolio while locking in three strategic collaborations to support its lead asset.

papers.title: RoboFollow: Unveiling the Instruction Following Mirage in Embodied Agents
papers.summary: Modern embodied agents achieve impressive success rates, yet their actual instruction-following ability is far weaker than these numbers suggest. We trace this illusion to a structural property we term low scene entropy: when a visual scene admits only one valid task, language becomes redundant and a policy can score highly while barely using it. We introduce RoboFollow, a diagnostic benchmark with three principles: (1) High Scene Entropy: each training scene supports multiple kinematically distinct task branches, making vision alone insufficient and forcing reliance on language.
